POV: you wandered off Đường Nguyễn Du and found the BBQ spot locals actually line up for.

Song Gia Food Phu Quoc. 4.8 stars. Smoke in the air. Meat on the grill. Bill stays under $30 a head.

This is the kind of place you stop photographing and just eat. Charcoal-grilled seafood and meats, no resort markup, no tourist menu.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
